summary: This is a routine ESOP allotment filing by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. via Form 6-K. The company allotted 12,100 equity shares of Re.1 each to employees upon exercise of stock options under existing ESOP schemes. No transaction price, premium, or board recommendation is provided, as the allotment is at predetermined exercise prices. There is no structural complexity or regulatory clock beyond standard India-listing disclosures. As a non-special-situation, vanilla equity issuance, there is no event-driven angle or risk-arb opportunity.
